questions.q: If ransomware started on one laptop right now, how far could it spread before anyone saw it?
questions.why: Turns endpoint coverage into business risk.

questions.q: How long does it take today to isolate a compromised machine?
questions.why: Isolation time is the number that limits damage.

questions.q: How many devices have no agent, including servers, branches and contractors?
questions.why: Uncovered devices are where attacks land.

questions.q: Do you know every operating system and version in use, and which are out of support?
questions.why: Unsupported systems need a different plan.

questions.q: Is prevention switched on everywhere, or are some groups still in detect-only mode?
questions.why: Detect-only left on by habit is a common gap.

questions.q: Are exclusions reviewed, and who can add one?
questions.why: Broad exclusions quietly turn protection off.

questions.q: Is device control or application control in use where it matters?
questions.why: Separates basic antivirus from real hardening.

questions.q: When the console raises a critical alert at night, who answers it?
questions.why: Coverage without response is a dashboard.
